description: Remove a custom domain from a site. The site itself is unaffected; only the custom hostname is detached. The {name}.vibedeploy.be subdomain keeps serving the site.

domain.description: The custom domain to remove (e.g. 'tester.subsite.site'). Provide this OR recordId.

recordId.description: The recordId returned by add_custom_domain. Provide this OR domain.

siteName.description: The site to detach the domain from.

name: remove_custom_domain
title: Detach a custom domain
